definitions.C1: burst: submitter same-day >=20 or submitter calendar-month >=40
definitions.C2: cohort: short-lived (<=120 d) submitter whose first submission falls in a cohort of >=5 first-time submitters within +-15 d under the same org
definitions.C2b: cohort (loose): short-lived submitter, >=8 first-time submitters within +-30 d, any org
definitions.C3: organisational surge: org calendar-month with >=100 submissions
